nodes.description: Immutable ADMIN address stored in BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy, used as the authorization anchor for the ifAdmin modifier.
Constant storage slot (EIP-1967 implementation slot) holding the delegatecall target address.
msg.sender used for admin authorization and fallback gating across the proxy contracts.
InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor receiving the admin address.
_willFallback override delegating to BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback.
BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor that permanently writes the admin into the immutable ADMIN state variable.
External admin() getter guarded by the ifAdmin modifier.
External implementation() getter guarded by the ifAdmin modifier.
External upgradeTo(address) guarded by ifAdmin, upgrades the proxy implementation.
External payable upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) guarded by ifAdmin that upgrades and delegatecalls arbitrary data.
_willFallback that forbids msg.sender == ADMIN from reaching the fallback path.
_implementation() reading the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via assembly sload.
_upgradeTo(address) internal routine that sets the implementation and emits Upgraded.
_setImplementation(address) internal routine that validates the target is a contract and sstores it into the implementation slot.
Payable fallback function that routes all non-admin calls to _fallback.
Abstract virtual _implementation() declaration in Proxy.
_delegate(address) assembly routine performing calldatacopy and delegatecall to the implementation.
Base virtual _willFallback hook executed at the start of every fallback.
_fallback() internal routine calling _willFallback then _delegate(_implementation()).
Address library isContract(address) using extcodehash to detect deployed code.
Address library sendValue(address,uint256) performing a low-level call with value.
Payable initialize(address,bytes) that sets the implementation once and delegatecalls initializer data.
delegatecall(newImplementation, data) inside upgradeToAndCall, executing arbitrary untrusted calldata in proxy context.
Assembly delegatecall(gas(), implementation, ...) inside _delegate, forwarding full msg.data to the implementation.
delegatecall(_logic, _data) inside initialize, executing arbitrary initializer calldata in proxy context.
Assembly sstore writing the new implementation address into the fixed implementation slot.
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount}('') forwarding value to an arbitrary address.

edges.reason: Constructor stores the admin parameter into the immutable ADMIN state variable.
Base constructor performs ADMIN = admin assignment.
Initializable proxy constructor receives the admin argument.
Derived constructor invokes the base constructor with admin.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender with ADMIN before executing admin().
ifAdmin compares msg.sender with ADMIN before executing implementation().
ifAdmin gates upgradeTo on msg.sender == ADMIN.
ifAdmin gates upgradeToAndCall on msg.sender == ADMIN.
_willFallback requires msg.sender != ADMIN, an access-control branch on caller identity.
Non-admin msg.sender is routed into the fallback function by the ifAdmin modifier.
admin() returns the ADMIN immutable value.
implementation() returns the result of _implementation().
upgradeTo passes newImplementation into _upgradeTo.
newImplementation parameter flows into _upgradeTo(address).
upgradeToAndCall passes newImplementation into _upgradeTo.

The slot local variable is assigned IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
